title: Agent Taiwan
tagline: Agent Taiwan is a DeFai agent and a no code social and DeFai agent builder as well
description:
Problem:
Interacting with on chain data and doing on chain actions is tough and has a learning curve 

It’s very difficult to create DeFai ai agents who can find profitable strategies or launch social ai agents who can provide valuable alpha and create their own community 

Solution

AgentTaiwan allows people to query and visualize on chain data with just a prompt on its own platform or on X without them even having a wallet

No code agent launcher allowing people to deploy their DeFai or social agent without writing any code in under 2 minutes

Agents that are deployed already:
-AgentTaipei: Users can perform on chain transactions or get their queries answered or their portfolios or any other data visualized by just tagging it on X 
-Greeky: An agent that deploys tokens every 10mins based on greek mythology 

Agents that can be deployed using the no code agent launcher:
-Social Agents: These agents can be used to provide alpha from real time data and even act on it with on chain actions such as deploying tokens, transferring funds, doing giveways and more (think of it like an AI KOL)

-trading bots such as copy traders, DCA bots, multi-statergy bots and more

-DeFai bots: bots that scan for oppurtunities with real time data access and perform on chain actions to maximise profitability
how_its_made:
Uses Groq for AI 
Metal for token deployments
Mobula for on chain metadata
Lunarcrush for social data
Curvegrid for on chain data and cloud wallets
1inch for portfolio apis, data and swapping

Every agent is an AWS lambda instance that can be triggered with specific time intervals, and is made up of 2 apis: data api: to do the action or fetch data required to complete the user's query, and character api to return the data/action result in the character pronpt of the user
